title: French Beef Soufflé Cutlet
description: A classic French-inspired dish featuring a tender beef cutlet topped with a rich and creamy soufflé.
instructions: Season the beef cutlet with salt and black pepper.
Dredge the cutlet in flour, shaking off excess.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the cutlet for 2-3 minutes on each side, then set aside.
In the same skillet, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Add the grated cheese and stir until melted.
Stir in the cream and bring to a simmer.
Remove from heat and stir in the beaten egg.
Pour the soufflé mixture over the beef cutlet.
Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the soufflé is puffed and golden brown.
